news.summary: Key TakeawaysElon Musk says many of NVIDIA’s supply deals rested on a handshake with Jensen Huang, and that some will be lost now that Huang has resigned as CEO. news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點：馬斯克表示，輝達許多供應協議建立在與黃仁勳的握手基礎上，現在黃仁勳已辭去CEO職位，部分協議將告吹。Dylan Patel 指出，谷歌已向輝達的小型供應商尋求產能，Alphabet 有現金支持，其 TPU 晶片由博通製造。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysSteve Eisman says AI capex could peak in 2027, and the hyperscalers could return to positive cash flow as soon as the second half of that year, if data center construction slows. Charlie Bilello says Meta spends 43% of its revenue on capex, compared with 39% for Microsoft, 34% for Alphabet and 27% for Amazon, so a slowdown would free up the largest share of revenue at Meta.
news.title: “Big Short” Investor: Big Tech Could Return to “Positive Cash Flow” in 2027. Meta Gains Most
news.title_zh: 「大空頭」投資人：大型科技股可能在 2027 回歸「正現金流」。Meta 獲益最大
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點：Steve Eisman 指出 AI 資本支出可能在 2027 見頂，若資料中心建設放緩，超大規模廠商最快可在該年下半年回歸正現金流。Charlie Bilello 指出 Meta 將 43% 營收用於資本支出，微軟為 39%，Alphabet 為 34%，Amazon 為 27%，因此放緩將釋出 Meta 最大比例營收。

news.summary: The orders extend Google TPU shipment visibility to 2029, while Nvidia GPUs and other AI accelerators mostly have visibility through 2027 or 2028, according to Ming-Chi Kuo.

news.summary_zh: 根據郭明錤表示，訂單將 Google TPU 出貨可見度延伸至 2029，而輝達 GPU 和其他 AI 加速器大多僅有可見度至 2027 或 2028。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysJason Calacanis says robotaxis would need 20 million vehicles doing 20-plus rides a day to reach 3% to 4% of global rides, as a Reuters columnist floats the idea of Alphabet buying Uber to strengthen Waymo. That math gives Uber years of ride volume, so its global network is worth more to Alphabet or Tesla as a purchase than as something to beat.
news.title: Robotaxis Need “20M AVs” for 3-4% of Global Rides, Says Jason Calacanis. Good News for Uber
news.title_zh: Robotaxis 需要「20M AVs」才能達到 3-4% 的全球叫車量，Jason Calacanis 指出。這對 Uber 是好消息
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要 Jason Calacanis 指出，robotaxis 需要 20 million 輛車輛，每天完成 20 趟以上的叫車，才能達到 3% to 4% 的全球叫車量，路透專欄作家提出 Alphabet 收購 Uber 以增強 Waymo 的想法。這筆帳讓 Uber 擁有多年的叫車量，因此其全球網絡對 Alphabet 或 Tesla 來說，作為收購目標比作為競爭對手更有價值。

news.summary: TD Securities estimated that S&P 500 inclusion could generate about $100 billion in buying from index funds.

news.summary: Key TakeawaysJason Calacanis says robotaxis would need 20 million vehicles doing 20-plus rides a day to reach 3% to 4% of global rides, as a Reuters columnist floats the idea of Alphabet buying Uber to strengthen Waymo. That math gives Uber years of ride volume, so its global network is worth more to Alphabet or Tesla as a purchase than as something to beat.
news.title: Robotaxis Need “20M AVs” for 3-4% of Global Rides, Says Jason Calacanis. Good News for Uber
news.title_zh: Robotaxis 需要「20M AVs」才能達到 3-4% 的全球叫車量，Jason Calacanis 指出。這對 Uber 是好消息

news.summary_zh: 鑑於其業務性質，Tesla 和 SpaceX 面臨的政治風險短期內不會消退。

news.summary: Anthropic said on Tuesday that it has launched its roadshow, a 7 to 10 day period ahead of an IPO in which a company pitches prospective institutional investors like mutual funds, pension funds and hedge funds. Meanwhile, the largest pure-play robotics company in the world by revenue and market cap is Intuitive Surgical , which makes the da Vinci Surgical System , a multi-armed contraption that human surgeons use on a remote-control basis to perform a variety of operations. But da Vinci was first unveiled over 25 years ago, and a new generation of robotics companies is aiming to further automate surgery by harnessing the latest advances in AI. items.title: Intuitive Surgical (NASDAQ:ISRG) Stock: Insider Gary Loeb Sells 400 Shares
items.summary: Intuitive Surgical, Inc. (NASDAQ:ISRG - Get Free Report) EVP Gary Loeb sold 400 shares of the company's stock in a transaction that occurred on Tuesday, November 10th. The stock was sold at an average price of $458.15, for a total value of $183,260.00. Following the transaction, the executive vice president directly owned 6,236 shares of the company's stock, valued at approximately $2,857,023.40. The trade was a 6.03% decrease in their ownership of the stock. The sale was disclosed in a document filed with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is accessible through this link. The transaction was executed under a pre-arranged Rule 10b5-1 trading plan.

items.title: Mosaic Raises Funds for Robotic Surgery
items.summary: Anthropic said on Tuesday that it has launched its roadshow, a 7 to 10 day period ahead of an IPO in which a company pitches prospective institutional investors like mutual funds, pension funds and hedge funds. Interestingly, the tentative valuation the Claude-maker set, of between $1.26 trillion to $1.4 trillion, was slightly lower than what investors initially expected. (And, it’s also around the $1.25 trillion valuation that OpenAI recently raised $11 billion at, despite the fact that Anthropic generates more revenue. That’s likely for several reasons, including that Anthropic likely wants its stock to have some wiggle room to trade up after its IPO.) Meanwhile, the largest pure-play robotics company in the world by revenue and market cap is Intuitive Surgical , which makes the da Vinci Surgical System , a multi-armed contraption that human surgeons use on a remote-control basis to perform a variety of operations. But da Vinci was first unveiled over 25 years ago, and a new generation of robotics companies is aiming to further automate surgery by harnessing the latest advances in AI. news.summary: Key TakeawaysThe Information reports that Nvidia’s interim CEO, Colette Kress, pushed back on a proposed $250 billion credit backstop for OpenAI while she was finance chief, and that Nvidia is expected to slow its AI investment strategy. Oracle has the most at stake: Steve Eisman puts about half of its $664 billion backlog with OpenAI, and its free cash flow was negative $23.
news.title: Nvidia’s Interim CEO Pushed Back on a “$250 Billion Credit Backstop” for OpenAI. Oracle Has the Most at Stake

news.summary_zh: 重點摘要The Information 報導，Nvidia 臨時執行長 Colette Kress 在擔任財務長時，反對提議的 $250 billion 信用擔保給 OpenAI，且預期 Nvidia 將放緩其 AI 投資策略。Oracle 風險最大：Steve Eisman 指出其約一半的 $664 billion 積壓訂單來自 OpenAI，且其自由現金流為負 $23。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysOracle sold $20 billion of stock and bonds days after capping new capital-market funding at that amount through fiscal 2030. Bloomberg reported that Microsoft is winding down a 2023 deal to rent AI computing from Oracle on older Nvidia chips.
news.title: CoreWeave Jumped 20% and Pulled Oracle Higher. Is It Time to Sell, or Load Up?
news.title_zh: CoreWeave 飆升 20% 並帶動 Oracle 上漲。是時候賣出，還是加碼？

news.summary: Key TakeawaysBloom Energy rose 13% in the past week, with Vertiv and Oracle, after CoreWeave and Constellation Energy raised their 2026 guidance. Bloom had no news of its own, and with its orders and rising estimates intact, the bounce looks like it has further to go.

news.summary: Key TakeawaysNebius stock fell 12% in a week as the midterms and a Microsoft report hit the neoclouds, IREN and CoreWeave included. Microsoft’s tighter oversight of Nebius’s projects is a bigger risk than the election, though Nebius carried a sliver of CoreWeave’s debt at midyear.
news.title: Nebius Sinks 12% in a Week: “Not All of These Companies Are Going to Make It”
